name: Beanshelf
subtitle: Coffee bags, shelved.
description: The Beanshelf source. Add this to AltStore or SideStore and install Beanshelf with your own Apple ID — no App Store, no developer account.

apps.name: Beanshelf
apps.subtitle: Coffee bags, shelved.
apps.localizedDescription: Photograph a bag of beans and it lands on a wooden shelf. The label is read on-device to fill in roaster, origin, variety and tasting notes; rate bags Untappd-style in quarter steps, log every brew with its recipe, and share beans with friends — cards, bean packs, or the built-in feed.

versions.localizedDescription: First release: the shelf, label scanning, brew log, leaderboard, themes, and the social feed.
